source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Why should you reserve some development time and usage budget after a skill has been drafted?

options.text: A longer drafting session guarantees that later errors cannot occur
options.feedback: More drafting alone does not establish reliability. Evaluation can reveal problems the draft did not anticipate.

options.text: Checking outputs can be replaced by choosing the most capable authoring model
options.feedback: A capable model can help develop the procedure, but its involvement does not establish that outputs satisfy your requirements.

options.text: Checking outputs can reveal changes the procedure still needs
options.feedback: Useful development includes testing and revision, so spending the entire budget on the first draft leaves important work undone.

options.text: Installing the finished folder makes all further verification unnecessary
options.feedback: Installation makes a skill available but does not prove that its outputs meet the task requirements.
